title: 第19章 洛萨之子的踪迹第20章 白发法师
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: “洛萨之子？”
听到这个名字，温雷的表情明显有些不对劲，他微微别过脸去，目光飘向路边的灌木丛，仿佛那丛草突然变得格外有趣。
就连瓦里安的表情都有些不太自然。他在心中暗暗吐槽：我怎么把这事给忘了？
他当然知道近来洛萨之子们正在开赴诅咒之地，要在那里建设一座守望堡，夜色镇确实是必经之路。
众人沿着泥泞的道路继续前行，为了缓解沉默带来的尴尬，艾伦随口问道：
“洛萨之子他们怎么会在这里？”
摩根老实回答：“这我就不知道了。据说是为了黑暗之门而来。”
“黑暗之门？”瓦里安故作不知，“黑暗之门不是已经被关闭了吗？”
他当然知道实情，近来诅咒之地又有大批兽人涌现，天知道那些绿皮是从哪个犄角旮旯冒出来的。
根据大法师卡德加的建议，联盟决定在诅咒之地建造一座守望堡，彻底遏制兽人的小动作。
但这些属于军事机密，不适合在公开场合细说。
艾伦听着他们的对话，脑海中隐约浮现出一些记忆碎片。
黑暗之门八年……
这个时间段，貌似马上就要衔接魔兽争霸3的剧情了。德拉诺的耐奥祖正在密谋重新开启黑暗之门，会不会和这个有关？
但很快他就摇了摇头。
无论如何，这种高层次的大佬争斗，不是他一个刚刚穿越过来的小趴菜能掺和的。
他只想找到斯塔文，完成对米拉娜的承诺，然后老老实实苟在暴风城，或者去乡下买块地，种种田，养养鸡，远离那些动不动就毁天灭地的破事......嗯，至少目前是这样的。
“额，”他轻咳一声，“我们就是去夜色镇处理一些小事情，应该……还是别打扰到洛萨之子的英雄们比较好。”
温雷猛猛点头，瓦里安也猛猛点头。
温雷害怕见到奥蕾莉亚·风行者，瓦里安害怕见到图拉扬。
前者不必说，温雷可是背着姐姐偷偷跑出来的，只为了证明自己能成为一名合格的游侠正在进行试炼。
后者，图拉扬作为联盟现任最高军事统帅，基本上是瓦里安的监护人，就是图拉扬带着避难的瓦里安回到暴风城继承的王位，摄政会议的那些大臣也是图拉扬安排的。
要是被图拉扬发现自己偷偷溜出暴风城，跑到这穷乡僻壤追查什么灭门案……
从森林中走出来，艾伦、斯黛拉和温雷回到了马车上。
摩根走在最前面带路，陷入了深深的纠结。
怎么办？
看这些人的反应，他们好像……有问题啊！
那个叫马迪亚斯的，听到洛萨之子表情就不自然；那个叫温雷的，更是明显在躲着什么。
他们不会是不法之徒吧？不会是在暴风城犯了事，逃到夜色镇避风头的吧？
作为一名正义的圣骑士，如果他发现这些人是不法之徒，理应抓捕他们，扭送当地治安官。
但是……
content_en:
;;
"Son of Lothar?"
Hearing this name, something was obviously wrong with Wen Lei's expression. He turned away slightly and his eyes drifted to the bushes on the roadside, as if the bushes suddenly became particularly interesting.
Even Varian's expression looked a little unnatural. He secretly complained in his heart: How could I forget this?
Of course he knew that the Sons of Lothar were heading to the Cursed Land recently to build a watch fortress there, and Night Town was indeed the only way to go.
Everyone continued to move forward along the muddy road. In order to relieve the embarrassment caused by the silence, Allen asked casually:
"Why are Lothar's sons here?"
Morgan answered honestly: "I don't know about that. It is said that they are here for the Dark Portal."
"The Dark Portal?" Varian pretended not to know, "Hasn't the Dark Portal been closed?"
Of course he knows the truth. Recently, a large number of orcs have appeared in the Cursed Land. God knows from which corner those green skins emerged.
Based on Archmage Khadgar's suggestion, the Alliance decided to build a watch fortress in the Cursed Lands to completely curb the orcs' small movements.
However, these are military secrets and are not suitable to be discussed in detail in public.
Allen listened to their conversation, and some memory fragments vaguely emerged in his mind.
Eight years in the Dark Portal...
At this time, it seems that the plot of Warcraft 3 will soon be connected. Ner'zhul of Draenor is plotting to reopen the Dark Portal. Could this be related to this?
But soon he shook his head.
In any case, this kind of high-level boss fight is not something he, a little kid who has just traveled through time, can get involved in.
He just wants to find Stavin, fulfill his promise to Mirana, and then stay in Stormwind City, or go to the countryside to buy a piece of land, plant fields, raise chickens, and stay away from those messy things that can destroy the world at every turn... Well, at least for now.
"Um," he coughed lightly, "We are just going to Night Town to deal with some small matters. It should be... better not to disturb the heroes of the Sons of Lothar."
Wen Lei nodded fiercely, and Varian also nodded fiercely.
Venray was afraid of meeting Alleria Windrunner, and Varian was afraid of meeting Turalyon.
Needless to say about the former, Wen Lei sneaked out behind his sister's back just to prove that he could become a qualified ranger and was undergoing trials.
In the latter, Turalyon, as the current supreme military commander of the alliance, is basically Varian's guardian. It was Turalyon who took Varian who had taken refuge back to Stormwind City to inherit the throne. The ministers of the regency council were also arranged by Turalyon.
If Turalyon found out that he had sneaked out of Stormwind City and went to this remote country to investigate some murder case...
Walking out of the forest, Alan, Stella and Wen Lei returned to the carriage.
Morgan walked at the front and led the way, falling into a deep tangle.
what to do?
Judging from the reactions of these people, it seems like... there is something wrong with them!
The man named Mathias had an unnatural expression when he heard the son of Lothar; the man named Wen Lei was clearly hiding something.
Aren't they lawbreakers? Could it be that he committed a crime in Stormwind City and fled to Night Town to avoid the limelight?
As a righteous paladin, if he discovers that these people are lawbreakers, he should arrest them and turn them over to the local sheriff.
but……
